author: AroundTheNFL
text:
#Chargers Pro Bowl OT Joe Alt is expected to miss this Sunday’s game against the #Broncos with a neck injury, sources say. 

Alt continues to rehab the injury suffered last week at Seattle, and there are no plans for IR.
